title: 门外脚步声  (Footsteps Outside the Gate)

segments.t: Two minutes to three at Courtyard Inn! Rooftop lanterns sway gently above twenty-eight clipped linen settings, four summer berry cakes gleam on white stands, and Qing, Mei, and Zhou gather near the open courtyard gate. Listen first.
三点敲响前赶紧检查一遍：西装扣好了，皮鞋擦亮了——我的眼镜呢？！
真是奇迹中的奇迹，周经理，眼镜稳稳架在您鼻梁上呢！
千万别碰它！一号桌已经备好热薄荷茶、红茶和温盘子啦。
宋老师在胡桃木钢琴旁就位了，二号房和六号房的客人都笑眯眯的！
咱们真在一百八十分钟里办成了一场六小时的庆祝会！
听——是不是市政钟楼沿着梧桐巷敲响三点了？
一声、两声、三声……等等，外头刚有一扇车门关上了！
有人把黄铜门铃摇了两下——那是兄弟俩的暗号！
从拱门往外瞧：志鹏正拎着一只磨旧的棕色皮箱呢！
走在志豪身边那位，拄着银手杖，戴着宽边草帽……
周经理，记得先把铁门把手往上轻轻一提，再微笑！
欢迎回到小院客栈，老朋友——整整三十个夏天，一星期都不差！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
三点敲响前赶紧检查一遍：西装扣好了，皮鞋擦亮了——我的眼镜呢？！

'Quick check before three strikes: jacket buttoned, leather shoes shined—wait, where are my glasses?!' "Qiaoxiang" describes a bell or clock "striking", and adding "yibian" after "jiancha" means "check through once from top to bottom".
真是奇迹中的奇迹，周经理，眼镜稳稳架在您鼻梁上呢！

'Miracle of miracles, Manager Zhou—your glasses are sitting squarely right on the bridge of your nose!' "Qiji zhong de qiji" builds "miracle of miracles" with "zhong" ("among"), while "jiazhe" pictures glasses propped neatly on his "biliang" ("nose bridge").
千万别碰它！一号桌已经备好热薄荷茶、红茶和温盘子啦。

'Do not touch them! Table one already has hot mint tea, black tea, and warm plates ready.' "Qianwan bie" (literally "ten thousand times don't") adds humorous urgency, and notice Chinese calls black tea "hongcha" ("red tea") for its brew color.
宋老师在胡桃木钢琴旁就位了，二号房和六号房的客人都笑眯眯的！

'Teacher Song is in place at the walnut piano, and the guests from Room Two and Room Six are smiling brightly!' "Jiuwei" means "in position and ready", and "xiaomimi" adds a sweet, beaming look to "xiao" ("smile").
咱们真在一百八十分钟里办成了一场六小时的庆祝会！
'We actually pulled off a six-hour celebration in a hundred and eighty minutes!' "Bancheng" joins "organize" with "succeed" to mean "pull off" an event, counted by "chang" for gatherings and shows.
听——是不是市政钟楼沿着梧桐巷敲响三点了？
'Listen—is that the municipal clock tower down Wutong Lane chiming three?' "Zhonglou" literally combines "bell" and "tower" for "clock tower", and "shi bu shi ..." floats a gentle guess.
一声、两声、三声……等等，外头刚有一扇车门关上了！

'One chime, two chimes, three chimes... wait, a car door just shut outside!' Sound events get counted with "sheng" ("sound/chime"), while "shan" serves as the flat-panel counter for a "chemen" ("car door").
有人把黄铜门铃摇了两下——那是兄弟俩的暗号！

'Someone just rang the brass gate bell twice—that is the signal from the brothers!' "Anhao" joins "secret" and "signal" for a prearranged cue, and "xiongdilia" affectionately groups "the two brothers" together.
从拱门往外瞧：志鹏正拎着一只磨旧的棕色皮箱呢！
'Peek through the archway: Peng is carrying a worn brown leather suitcase!' "Mojiu" literally means "rubbed old" for a beloved, scuffed suitcase, while "qiao" is a lively spoken word for "look".
走在志豪身边那位，拄着银手杖，戴着宽边草帽……
'And walking beside Hao with a silver walking stick and a wide-brimmed straw hat...' "Zhu" specifically means leaning on a "shouzhang" ("walking stick"), paired cleanly with "dai" for wearing a hat.
周经理，记得先把铁门把手往上轻轻一提，再微笑！
'Remember to lift the iron gate handle slightly upward first, Zhou, and smile!' "Bashou" joins "grasp" and "hand" for "handle", and "yi ti" captures one crisp upward tug.
欢迎回到小院客栈，老朋友——整整三十个夏天，一星期都不差！

'Welcome back to Courtyard Inn, my old friend—thirty whole summers ago, to the very week!' "Zhengzheng" emphasizes a full, exact count, and "yi xingqi dou bu cha" literally says "not even a single week off".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

周经理，记得先把铁门把手往上轻轻一提，再微笑！
欢迎回到小院客栈，老朋友——整整三十个夏天，一星期都不差！
Three chimes ring out, the gate latch lifts smoothly, and after thirty summers the mapmaker of Room Eight steps back under the courtyard tree! End of Episode Five—see you in the Season Three finale!
